name: FUJIAN SANFAN Sports Products Co., Ltd.
description: FUJIAN SANFAN is an OEM/ODM manufacturer of yoga mats and fitness equipment based in Jinjiang, Fujian, China, founded in 2013. TPE yoga mats from 100 pcs MOQ, bulk OEM PU/rubber mats from 300 pcs, custom-printed PU rubber mats from 1 piece, foam rollers from 500 pcs, physical samples with your own logo and packaging in 7 days, 10 production lines and an annual capacity of 1,000,000+ yoga mats. ISO 9001:2015 · RoHS 2.0 tested · Prop 65 tested · amfori BSCI audited (renewal in progress). Exporting worldwide with FOB, EXW, CIF or DDP terms.
